title: AlphaEvolve raises nine Ramsey lower bounds
summary: AlphaEvolve-generated search algorithms improved bounds such as R(3,13) from 60 to 61, R(4,16) from 170 to 174 and R(4,19) from 213 to 219. The paper does not describe independent verification; search code is public. arXiv preprint, latest version read.
